verdict.rationale: Obsidian documents that notes are Markdown-formatted plain text, which implies heading-style formatting. Hands-on reports describe a fast editor that "gets out of the way," a built-in Vim mode that works well apart from minor cursor glitches, and inline embedding of other notes; the mobile page also lists a Command Palette. However, the evidence never explicitly covers callouts, tables, code blocks or media embedding, and one user notes PDF embedding is weaker than Logseq's. Missing for 10: first-party docs on callouts, tables, code blocks and media/image embeds; documentation of keyboard shortcuts and hotkeys for formatting.
